map.判断 97 是否为素数：只需试除到 √97≈9.8，即 2,3,5,7。均不能整: To test whether 97 is prime, trial-divide only up to √97≈9.8, i.e. 2,3,5,7. None divides it, so 97 is prime. 1 is not prime; 2 is the smallest prime and the only even prime.
map.判断 91：√91≈9.5，试除 7 得 91=7×13，故为合数（容易误以为是: Testing 91: √91≈9.5, and trial-dividing by 7 gives 91=7×13, so it is composite (easily mistaken for a prime).
map.为什么试除只要到 √n？: Why is trial division only needed up to √n?
map.若 n 有因子 a×b=n 且 a≤b，则 a≤√n；一旦超过 √n 还没找到因: If n has a factor pair a×b=n with a≤b, then a≤√n; once we pass √n without finding a factor, any larger factor would pair with a smaller factor already tested, so none can remain - testing up to √n is enough.
map.不是。素数定义为恰有两个正因子（1 和自身）的数；1 只有一个正因子，被排除在素: No. A prime is defined as a number with exactly two positive divisors (1 and itself); 1 has only one positive divisor and is therefore excluded, by modern convention.
